dct_title_s: Polk County, Iowa, 1938, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BKO; form of individual image numbering: BKO-2-[number], BKO-3-[number], BKO-5-[number], BKO-6-[number], BKO-7-[number], or BKO-8-[number]."Date of completion October 8, 1938" Flown by Iowa Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
